narration: In the first stage, Geometry-aware point sampling receives point clouds Pt and Pt+1, performing eigen feature computation, thresholding, and random sampling to isolate key points.
Next, View-based partitioning organizes the sampled points by azimuthal angle into four distinct directional partitions: front, left, right, and rear views.
In the third stage, Feature extraction and matching applies PointHop++ to extract geometric features and match correspondences across views.
Finally, Motion estimation and update calculates rotation and translation, updates the estimated trajectory, and advances the time step from t to t+1 in an iterative loop.
